title: Binding mode prediction of imidazothiadiazoles against insect ecdysone receptors via a combination of AlphaFold3 and molecular simulations.
authors: Yokoi, Taiyo; Nishiwaki, Hisashi; Yamauchi, Satoshi; Nakagawa, Yoshiaki
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold3和分子模拟预测杀虫剂配体与昆虫蜕皮激素受体的结合模式，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA，方法可迁移性有限，仅间接相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Imidazothiadiazoles (ITDs) are a group of non-steroidal ecdysone agonists that possess potent binding affinity against lepidopteran ecdysone receptors (EcRs). We previously conducted quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) analyses and molecular docking simulations of ITDs; however, the detailed molecular mechanism of the ligand-EcR interaction remained unclear. RESULTS: In this study, AlphaFold3, a deep learning model predicting biomolecular interactions, was used to elucidate the binding mode of ITDs against the receptor. AlphaFold3 predicted a range of binding mode candidates, which were screened using a series of computational methods, including clustering, molecular dynamics simulations, and binding free-energy calculations. The identified binding mode reasonably accounted for the receptor binding affinity of ITDs, including those synthesized de novo in this study, and was compatible with our previous QSAR results. CONCLUSION: The results provide robust evidence for the biological significance of the current binding model. The ITD-EcR interaction involved an induced-fit mechanism, which is hardly accessible with standard docking algorithms. The present methodology will serve as a foundation for understanding ligand-protein interactions of other pest control agents that are difficult to resolve experimentally. abstract_zh: 背景：咪唑并噻二唑（ITDs）是一类非甾体蜕皮激素激动剂，对鳞翅目昆虫蜕皮激素受体（EcRs）具有强效结合亲和力。我们此前对ITDs进行了定量构效关系（QSAR）分析和分子对接模拟；然而，配体与EcR相互作用的详细分子机制仍不明确。结果：在本研究中，利用AlphaFold3（一种预测生物分子相互作用的深度学习模型）来阐明ITDs与受体的结合模式。AlphaFold3预测了一系列结合模式候选，并通过一系列计算方法进行筛选，包括聚类分析、分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算。所识别的结合模式合理地解释了ITDs的受体结合亲和力，包括本研究新合成的化合物，并与我们之前的QSAR结果相符。结论：这些结果为当前结合模型的生物学意义提供了有力证据。ITD-EcR相互作用涉及诱导契合机制，这是标准对接算法难以实现的。本方法将为理解其他难以通过实验解析的害虫防治剂的配体-蛋白质相互作用奠定基础。(c) 2025 化学工业学会。
